extracted.name: Hot Chocolate Lava Cake
extracted.description: This Chocolate cake is like brownie meets chocolate lava cake! So rich and delicious, plus so simple to throw together! Serve with some vanilla Ice cream!
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cups unsweetened cocoa powder such as Scharffen Berger
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder such as Scharffen Berger
instruction_lines: In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and cocoa powder. Create a well in the dry ingredients and pour in milk, melted butter, and vanilla. Stir together until a thick batter forms.
Spread into an ungreased 9x13 casserole dish with high sides. As this will rise and bubble.
In a separate bowl, stir sugar, brown sugar, and cocoa powder together. Sprinkle over the top of the batter evenly.
Pour hot water onto a spoon over the entire thing {WITHOUT STIRRING A THING!}.
Bake for 40 minutes or once the middle is set. {Be sure to place it on a baking sheet in case it bubbles over.} Serve HOT, with Ice Cream!

Note* If you want to make this recipe ahead of time just make the brownie batter, spread into the casserole, mix the topping but hold off on sprinkling it on, and hole off on the hot water till you are ready to bake. Can make the day before.
